sn56.96-101:1.1: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye chedanavadhanabandhanaviparāmosaālopasahasākārā paṭiviratā atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye chedanavadhanabandhanaviparāmosaālopasahasākārā appaṭiviratā.
sn56.96-101:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
